title: Free Personal Flight Map & Flight Log — AirportsBoard
description: Create a map of your flights. Add airports, view routes and approximate distances, keep your flight log, back it up and export a PNG to share.
heading: My flight map
intro: The AirportsBoard flight map is a free personal flight log in your browser. Manually add departure and arrival airports to see your routes, flight count and approximate distances between airports.
stepsHeading: How to create your flight map
steps: Choose Add flight and find both airports by city, name or IATA code.
Add a date and flight number if you remember them. Both fields are optional.
View all your flights or filter by year. Save a PNG to share and a JSON backup to restore your log.

faq.question: Is the flight map free?
faq.answer: Yes. You can add flights and save images without payment or registration.

faq.question: Will my flights remain after refreshing?
faq.answer: Yes, in the same browser at the same address. Clearing browser data removes the local log. There is no automatic syncing between devices.

faq.question: How do I move my log to another phone?
faq.answer: Open Save and backup, save the JSON file and restore it on the other device. A preview appears before adding records. Matching records are not duplicated; conflicting records do not replace your current ones.

faq.question: Is this a live aircraft tracking map?
faq.answer: No. It shows past flights that you enter manually. It does not track aircraft or import flight history from your email.

faq.question: How are distance and countries counted?
faq.answer: Distance is an estimate of the shortest path over a sphere between airports, not the aircraft’s actual track. The country count refers to airports on your map and does not prove that you entered those countries.

faq.question: What is visible in the image I share?
faq.answer: Routes, cities, airport codes and statistics. Exact dates and flight numbers are not shown in the PNG. The JSON backup includes your log and any dates and flight numbers you entered.
